description: This file provides TypeScript type definitions for the 'timers/promises' API in Node.js, including function signatures, interfaces, and module exports.

methods.name: function setTimeout<T = void>(delay?: number, value?: T, options?: TimerOptions): Promise<T>/ setTimeout
methods.description: Returns a Promise that fulfills after a specified delay, optionally with a provided value.

methods.name: setImmediate
methods.description: Returns a Promise that fulfills immediately with a provided value.

methods.name: setInterval
methods.description: Returns an async iterator that yields values at specified intervals.

methods.name: scheduler.wait
methods.description: An experimental method that resolves a promise after a delay, compatible with scheduling APIs.

methods.name: scheduler.yield
methods.description: An experimental method that yields control, similar to setImmediate.

ctags.name: setTimeout
ctags.pattern: /^    function setTimeout<T = void>(delay?: number, value?: T, options?: TimerOptions): Promise<T>/
